interface.longDescription: An independent MIT-licensed port of Lauren Tan's pstack. Includes 54 skills, 24 engineering principles, and 23 playbooks for planning, architecture, implementation, review, writing, testing, and verification. A shared workflow selects a Codex or Dots runtime adapter from actual host capabilities. Dots orchestration requires supported tools and a configured local or cloud execution environment. Local skills require a connected computer. Optional helpers have explicit dependency setup. The package does not supply Cursor cloud APIs, Claude/Grok panels, Grok Bot webhooks, or Benny automation. Runtime support and verification limits are documented in the repository.
